# Brow Arc Threading

> Expert eyebrow threading, tinting, lamination, waxing and lash extension services across 5 locations in Melbourne, Australia.

Brow Arc Threading is a beauty salon brand specializing in precision threading and brow shaping, operating studios in Brandon Park, Southland, Pakenham, Stud Park, and Heidelberg.
